value.name: Whitfield waits for Asha to reveal the truth
value.description: Whitfield silently signals that he has been waiting to hear whether Asha will make him guess what she means.
evidence: Whitfield's two fingers stayed on the corner of the page, but something at the edge of his mouth adjusted, the small recalibration of a man who had been waiting to hear whether she would make him guess.

value.name: Asha realizes her confession will determine Devin's fate
value.description: Asha understands that what she says next will decide whether Devin's filing is treated as a minor mistake or as her own cost.
evidence: she understood that whatever she said next would decide whether Devin's name on the Tuesday filing read as a junior associate's lapse or as the cost of hers.

value.name: Asha pushes the document to Whitfield
value.description: Asha releases the page and slides it fully across the desk to Whitfield, yielding control of the document to him.
evidence: Asha let her fingers leave the page and slid it the last inch across the blotter, releasing the corner so the document sat alone between them, fully on Whitfield's side of the desk.

value.name: Asha admits wiring the deposit
value.description: Asha states that she personally wired the deposit, implying responsibility without naming the source of the money.
evidence: "I wired the deposit myself," she said, the same measured distance as the three sentences before, no adjective on it.
She did not say from what account, and she did not say what it had emptied

value.name: Whitfield infers Asha used personal funds
value.description: Whitfield registers that Asha's deposit came from her own money rather than the firm's or her brother's.
evidence: she watched him register the verb and the pronoun together, the small tightening at the edge of his mouth that meant he had heard the I and understood it was not the firm's money and not her brother's.

value.name: Rosa stops sending messages
value.description: Asha notices that Rosa's phone messages have ceased, suggesting Rosa has paused whatever she was about to send.
evidence: The phone at her hip stayed quiet for the first time in twenty minutes; whatever Rosa had been about to send next, she had stopped sending.

value.name: Whitfield takes control of the document
value.description: Whitfield lifts his fingers from the page, pulls it under his palm, and shifts his attention from Devin's signature to Asha.
evidence: Whitfield finally lifted his two fingers off the corner of the page, drew it under his palm, and looked at Asha rather than at Devin's signature.

value.name: Asha prepares to continue speaking
value.description: Asha holds her posture and keeps eye contact as she begins to speak again, setting up a consequential revelation.
